# Backup schedule actual-source corpus

The first `backup-schedule-{UTC,Europe-Vilnius,America-New_York}.json` captures are **invalid/superseded historical evidence**. They are retained unchanged so their bytes and provenance remain inspectable. The original capture reset could run before a prior coordinator loop's final microtask; its manual-join/paused trace demonstrates contamination. Do not use these coordinator traces as parity or behavioral RED authority. The schedule math runs before coordinator scenarios and is unaffected, but final parity uses the separately captured isolated corpus.

The corrected generator awaits real coordinator loop cleanup and explicitly asserts that its queue loop, terminal waiters and running flags have drained before resetting scenarios. Capture is explicit remote write mode only. Ordinary tests must never regenerate fixtures. The production JS scheduler/hook/settings files stay at their recorded dispatch source hashes for corrected capture.

The active corpus is exactly the three `backup-schedule-isolated-UTC.json`, `backup-schedule-isolated-Europe-Vilnius.json`, and `backup-schedule-isolated-America-New_York.json` files. `src-core/tests/backup_schedule.rs` names each with an explicit SHA-256 assertion; no glob or newest-file selection exists. They contain 632 cases each, including 585 pure scheduling cases. Captured remotely at commit `ecc5d230269e521d14fc7b1f6fe679aeefb6a451`, tree `3e6a4300c4cd903f5d19de3a9b11a860080f7fe4`, on the same dispatch JS source hashes. Each reset asserts `_queueRunning === false`, `_terminalWaiters.size === 0`, and no truthy `_running` value after real terminal cleanup and microtasks settle. The isolated manual join trace has only account one running, restores `paused_offline`, and leaves account two queued.

The isolated corpus was decoded directly from three clean marked base64 stdout blocks in `/tmp/row14-isolated-red.log`. No answers were generated locally or edited. The first UTC capture's stdout needed exclusion of one identified interleaved stderr diagnostic; the corrected capture has clean contiguous blocks. The first capture's coordinator traces and any tests depending on them are not authoritative. The earlier pure schedule RED is independently unaffected: math ran first and depends only on its arguments/zone, before any coordinator scenario.
